name: wblstat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = wblstat(1, 2); [m_v, v_v] = wblstat([1 2 3], [1 2 3]); [m_b, v_b] = wblstat(2, [0.5 1 2]); m_a0 = wblstat(0, 1); m_b0 = wblstat(1, 0); m_aneg = wblstat(-1, 1);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = wblstat(a, b). Weibull(scale=a, shape=b): m = a·Γ(1+1/b), v = a²·(Γ(1+2/b) - Γ(1+1/b)²). Vectorised. a<=0 or b<=0 => NaN.
